answer: A Sybil-resistant economy for AI agents deploys a token-gated identity jetty, where entities must lock native tokens to register a verified identity. Spawning fake agents demands paying this token fee per identity, economically ruining a mass attacker. The attacker's false fable of cheap, infinite identities crumbles against this barrier, forcing them to buy substantial value and risk total loss. Thus, this ivory-gated protocol ensures legitimate agents operate without prohibitive costs, securing market integrity against duplication.
